text: As a horse when he has run, a dog when he has tackled the game, a bee when it has made the honey, so a man when he has done a good act does not call out for others to come and see, but he goes on to another act, as a vine goes on to produce again the grapes in season.
author: Marcus Aurelius
location: On campaign on the Danube frontier, e.g. Carnuntum or Sirmium (presumed)
